title: Reduction of effective fppf descent for a morphism property to affine singleton covers
statement: Let $\mathcal P$ be a property of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], invariant under isomorphism. Suppose (i) it is preserved by arbitrary base change [def-pc-fibre-product]; (ii) whenever $h_j:Y_j\to B_j$ have $\mathcal P$ for $1\le j\le m$, the morphism $\coprod_jY_j\to\coprod_jB_j$ of coproducts [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] has $\mathcal P$, including $m=0$; and (iii) for every flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism $p:A\to B$ of finite presentation between affine schemes, every scheme descent datum on $V\to A$ [def-pd-descent-datum] with $\mathcal P(V\to A)$ is effective. Here finite presentation means locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then for every fppf covering $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] and every scheme descent datum $(V_i,\phi_{ij})$ with $\mathcal P(V_i\to T_i)$, that datum is effective. In the family notation, $\phi_{ij}:V_i\times_T T_j\simeq T_i\times_T V_j$ are isomorphisms over $T_i\times_T T_j$ satisfying the cocycle on triple overlaps; effectiveness means a $T$-scheme $V_0$ with compatible isomorphisms $V_0\times_T T_i\simeq V_i$. All schemes and families are taken in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, specialization to tau=fppf; invoked by Tag 02W8 in its first proof paragraph.

proof.text: Put $A=\coprod_iT_i$ and $Z=\coprod_iV_i$. We first express the family datum as a singleton datum $D$ on $Z\to A$ over $T$. For any $H\to A$, the inverse images $H_i$ of the disjoint open components $T_i$ are disjoint opens covering $H$. They represent $H\times_AT_i$: a morphism to $H$ whose composite lands in $T_i$ factors uniquely through that open subscheme. Thus $H\cong\coprod_iH_i$, by gluing the inverse component maps. Applying this to the relevant projections gives $A\times_TA=\coprod_{i,j}(T_i\times_TT_j)$ and the corresponding decompositions for $Z\times_TA$, $A\times_TZ$, and triple products. On component $(i,j)$ define the transport of $D$ to be $\phi_{ij}$; the component inverses glue too. The cocycle follows component by component from the given family cocycle, and equality on the open cover implies equality globally. Conversely, restricting $D$ to those components recovers exactly the original datum. This is the explicit construction of Tag 023X, rather than an invocation of an uncited equivalence.

source.place: Tag 02W3, affine-base proof using Tag 023X (lemma-family-is-one); explicit disjoint-open construction in the proof of 023X

proof.text: The singleton $f:A\to T$ is fpqc. At a point in the component $T_i$, its local ring map is that of $T_i\to T$, so it is flat. For every affine open $U\subset T$, the family $\{T_i\times_TU\to U\}$ is fppf by the cited base-change lemma. The affine-refinement lemma supplies finitely many affine opens $W_j\subset T_{i(j)}\times_TU$ whose images cover $U$. Each $T_i\times_TU$ is the open inverse image of $U$ in $T_i$, by the same factorization through open subschemes as in step 1; hence each $W_j$ is an affine open of $A$. Their images under $f$ have union exactly $U$. Together with flatness this is precisely the definition of an fpqc singleton covering. This argument applies to any fppf family, without assuming its index set finite.

source.place: Tag 02W3, preliminary refinement argument and affine-base paragraph; Topologies Tag 021P (lemma-fppf-affine), and fpqc definition Tag 022B

proof.text: Fix an affine open $U\subset T$. Write $A_U=A\times_TU$ and $Z_U=Z\times_AA_U$. Restrict $D$ to a datum $D_U$ over $A_U/U$: the identity $A_U\times_UA_U\cong(A\times_TA)\times_TU$ follows by the two fibre-product universal properties, and the analogous identity in degree three shows that the restricted transport satisfies the cocycle. The projection $Z_U\to Z$ intertwines these transports. Choose the finite refinement $W_j\subset T_{i(j)}\times_TU$ of step 2, and let $C=\coprod_{j=1}^mW_j$. The refinement maps give $h:C\to A_U$ over $U$. By the coproduct and fibre-product descriptions of step 1, $Z_U\times_{A_U}C\cong\coprod_jQ_j$, where $Q_j=V_{i(j)}\times_{T_{i(j)}}W_j$. Each $Q_j\to W_j$ has $\mathcal P$ by hypothesis (i). Notice that no property of the infinite coproduct $Z\to A$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 02W3, preliminary observation about preservation of the property under pullback, affine-base proof, and restriction to an affine open in the general-base proof

proof.text: The morphism $p:C\to U$ is flat, surjective, and of finite presentation between affine schemes. Indeed, $C$ is affine by the finite-coproduct clause of the affine-permanence lemma. Flatness follows at every point from the local ring map on its open component $W_j$, and surjectivity follows from the chosen joint coverage. Every $W_j\to U$ is locally of finite presentation by the refinement lemma, so $p$ is locally of finite presentation by the finite-coproduct lemma. A morphism between affine schemes is affine, hence quasi-compact and separated, in particular quasi-separated, by affine permanence. These properties give finite presentation with exactly the convention in the statement. Also $\{p\}$ is an fpqc covering: for every affine open $B\subset U$, its preimage is affine because $p$ is affine, and this one affine open has image $B$ by surjectivity. If $m=0$, the refinement covers only $U=\varnothing$ and the same conclusions hold vacuously.

source.place: Tag 02W3, affine-base paragraph: the finite standard fppf family is replaced by its single affine coproduct cover; Topologies Tags 021P and 021Q

proof.text: Pull $D_U$ back along $h:C\to A_U$ using the canonical-pullback-datum lemma. Its underlying scheme is $Z_U\times_{A_U}C=\coprod_jQ_j$ as in step 3, and its projection to $Z_U$ is cartesian over $h$ and intertwines transports. Hypothesis (ii) gives $\mathcal P(\coprod_jQ_j\to C)$; invariance under isomorphism gives the property for the chosen pullback. For $m=0$ this uses precisely the explicitly assumed empty coproduct case. Step 4 verifies every hypothesis on $p$ required by (iii), so (iii) makes this pulled-back datum effective over $U$.

source.place: Tag 02W3, affine-base paragraph, application of assumptions (2) and (3) after Tag 023X

proof.text: The singleton $A_U\to U$ is fpqc, being the base change of $f:A\to T$ from step 2. The singleton $C\to U$ is fpqc by step 4 and factors through it by $h$. The datum of step 5 is the cartesian pullback of $D_U$ with transport compatibility, exactly the additional hypotheses of the cited refinement-reflects-effectivity lemma. Applying that lemma to its effective pullback shows that $D_U$ itself is effective. Thus for every affine open $U\subset T$ we have effective data $D_U$ on $Z_U\to A_U$, with the transport compatibility to $D$ proved in step 3.

source.place: Tag 02W3, affine-base paragraph invoking Tag 02W0 (lemma-refine-coverings-fully-faithful), expressed via the existing singleton refinement lemma

proof.text: Apply the cited effectivity-open-local lemma to $f:A\to T$ and $D$. Step 2 provides its singleton fpqc hypothesis; steps 3 and 6 provide effective restricted data on every affine open and the required projection/transport compatibility. It yields a $T$-scheme $V_0$ and an isomorphism $V_0\times_TA\cong Z$ identifying its canonical datum with $D$. Restrict this isomorphism to the open component $T_i\subset A$. The fibre-product universal property identifies its left side with $V_0\times_TT_i$ and its right side with $V_i$, as in step 1. Compatibility with $D$ on the component $T_i\times_TT_j$ is exactly compatibility with $\phi_{ij}$. These are the required compatible isomorphisms for the original family. No claim that $V_0\to T$ has $\mathcal P$ is needed or made.

source.place: Tag 02W3, general-base proof: relative gluing over all affine opens, and the final recovery of the family isomorphisms

proof_origin.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, proof for tau=fppf; Tag 023X gives the explicit family-to-singleton construction; the existing singleton refinement and open-local-effectivity lemmas realize Tag 02W0 and the general-base gluing paragraph.
